note: Drawn from spec-demos.md §3.2 (the 41 verdicted rows) and design-benchmark.md §1.4. Every price in must/mustAny is in data/patisserie-nour.json; every other string is in brain/patisserie-nour.md.

cases.why: spec-demos Q1. show_products plus @what-there-is. The failure to watch for is the whole catalogue written out in text, which the brain file forbids and which is also four messages long.
spec-demos Q22, a plain catalogue lookup. The never list is the neighbouring product's prices: picking the baklawa row instead of the makroud row is the one realistic way to get this wrong.
spec-demos Q23. The fee and the area are both in @pickup-or-delivery. Tests that the answer does not also ask retrait-or-livraison at a client who is still comparing.

spec-demos Q30. The catalogue stops at 1 kg / 75dt. 10 × 75 = 750dt would be stripped by lib/guard.js and the client would get a mutilated answer. A 9 says plainly that a large order needs the shop, and asks one thing.

spec-demos Q16. The shop has no address anywhere in the repo, yet it sells cakes for retrait. Any street name in this answer is invented, which is why the never list is the three words a street name starts with.

spec-demos Q13. The brain file tells the assistant to answer «how long it keeps» in one short line, and the fact is nowhere — an instruction to answer with nothing to answer from. The most likely failure in the whole set.

say: N7eb gâteau au chocolat l 10 personnes
cases.why: The full order, one question per turn in the order the brain file sets. Tests that the price is given once, that retrait skips @address, and that the same spelling of anahi / behi survives four answers.

A size changed mid-order, then four details in one message. Tests that the new price replaces the old one without restating both, and that the order is saved in the same answer instead of asking for a confirmation. No never list: 75dt is correct on turn 1 and wrong from turn 2 on, which only the judge can see.

say: slm 3andkom gato l 10 personne w 9adech yji w twaslou l sakiet ezzit wala le
cases.why: Three questions, no punctuation, «gato» (lib/catalog.js ALIASES maps gato → gateau). Tests: answers the cake question with a real catalogue price, is honest that Sakiet Ezzit is not «Sfax ville» (spec-demos Q24), and still ends with at most ONE question (R11).

say: shu 3andkom bel baklawa? biddi kilo hal2
cases.why: Levantine client (09 §3). The answer must be Tunisian — chnowa / n7eb / tawa — give the 1 kg price from the catalogue, and not mirror one syllable of the client's dialect. Raw-output scoring again: derja.js SWAP would hide shu → chnowa and biddi → n7eb.
